about: (v352-A) Nahw342Engine.tawkidPron (Ibn ʿAqīl p. 891) measured over every story: authored lines naming «توكيد» on a detached pronoun agreeing with the engine 20 → 28, the engine's «توكيد» 47 → 55, exact lines against an author 27 → 27 (none new). The one new contradiction the first cut made — al-kafiya:27:s7:30, «وَالتَّقْدِيرُ أَحْسِنْ أَنْتَ بِزَيْدٍ», al-Akhfash's estimate where أَنْتَ is the doer (the author: «لفظ محكي … الفاعل المقدر عند الأخفش») — was the engine's: the rule is now silent after «التقدير / أي». No record to judge.
